questions.stem: What is each part called when an object is divided into two equal parts?
questions.solution: When an object is divided into two equal parts, each part is called one half. This is because the term 'half' specifically refers to one of two equal portions of a whole. The other options, such as one third, one fourth, and one fifth, describe divisions into three, four, and five equal parts, which do not match the condition of dividing into two parts.

questions.stem: Which of the following represents one-half of a dhokla?
choices: One part of two equal parts
Two parts of four equal parts
Three parts of six equal parts
One part of four equal parts
questions.solution: One-half of a dhokla is represented by one part of two equal parts. The correct answer is 'One part of two equal parts'. 'Two parts of four equal parts' and 'Three parts of six equal parts' also represent one-half but are not the simplest form. 'One part of four equal parts' represents one-fourth.

questions.stem: If a dhokla is shared equally among 8 people, what fraction of the dhokla does each person get?
questions.solution: If a dhokla is shared equally among 8 people, each person gets 1/8 of the dhokla. The correct answer is '1/8'. '1/4' and '1/2' represent larger portions, while '1/6' is not the correct fraction for 8 people.

questions.stem: If a box has 16 barfis and each part is 1/4 of the total, how many barfis are in each part?
questions.solution: Dividing 16 barfis into 4 equal parts means each part has 16 ÷ 4 = 4 barfis. The other options are incorrect.

hi.solution: वर्ग को 8 समान भागों में विभाजित किया गया है और उनमें से 3 भाग छायांकित किए गए हैं। भिन्न 3/8 है। सही उत्तर 3/8 है। अन्य विकल्प इस स्थिति के अनुरूप नहीं हैं।

mr.solution: चौरस 8 समान भागांमध्ये विभागला गेला आहे, आणि त्यापैकी 3 भाग छायाचित्रित केले गेले आहेत. भागाची अंश आहे 3/8. योग्य उत्तर 3/8 आहे. इतर विकल्पांमध्ये विविध अंश आहेत जे या स्थितीसाठी अनुलक्षित नाहीत.
